documentation.content: `/api/v1/health/freshness` answered non-2xx from at least two regions for 10 minutes. It returns 503 when a source is past its threshold: IQAir stations (180 min), Punjab EPA (180 min) or satellite fires (540 min since the last successful ingest-fires run). Open https://hawanama-152782825429.asia-south1.run.app/api/v1/health/freshness and read `sources[].status`, `last_run_error` and `runs`. For fires see the runbook at the top of apps/api/app/services/fires.py (key rotation, satellites).
